author: April Clyburne-Sherin

steps_raw.instruction: Acquire one 8.5" x 11" sheet of white paper and one black ballpoint pen.
Draw a small (1mm) dot in the top left corner of the paper, 1cm from the top, 1 cm from the left edge. Label this dot "A".
Draw a small (1mm) dot in the top left corner of the paper, 1cm from the top, 2 cm from "A". Label this dot "B".
Draw a line between dots "A" and "B".
Draw a small (1mm) dot 2 cm directly below dot "B". Label this dot "C".
Draw a small (1mm) dot 1 cm directly to the right of dot "C". Label this dot "D".
Draw a line between dots "B" and "C".
Draw a line between dots "C" and "D".
Draw a small (1mm) dot 1 cm directly above dot "D". Label this dot "E".
Draw a line between dots "D" and "E".
Draw a small (1mm) dot 2 cm directly below dot "C". Label this dot "F".
Draw a line between dots "C" and "F".
Draw a small (1mm) dot 2 cm directly below dot "D". Label this dot "G".
Draw a line between dots "D" and "G".
Draw a line between dots "C" and "G".
Draw a line between dots "A" and "C".
In the triangle formed between dots "A", "B", and "C", draw a small circle (2mm) with a dot inside the circle.
Give the triangle a smiley face!!!
